chapter: The trio at Chess and The In Crowd
title: Who was 'Sonny' in the Chess shipping room
summary: Lewis explains Sonny was just a shipping clerk; Brown wondered if it was Sonny Boy Williamson, and mentions Muddy Waters painting the Chess house.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: When you said you did your audition for the Chess brothers, and you said Sonny came in, which Sonny? Who . . . ?
He was just a guy that worked in the shipping department. I never got his name, because they always just called him Sonny.
Okay. The reason I brought that up, I didn’t know if it was Sonny Boy Williamson or . . .
Which you couldn’t – because I heard they had Muddy Waters out there painting their house.
